title: Tourism service supply chains in ten emerging economies: data collection and audited analysis notebooks
description:
Versioned computational materials for a study of reported disruption exposure and customer impact in tourism service supply chains across ten emerging economies. The frozen analytical run contains 51,037 reviews from 11,500 providers in 29 cities.

Contents. The deposit includes a dry-run collection notebook documenting the Google Places retrieval protocol; an audited analysis notebook implementing exclusions, frozen dictionary coding, supplier-clustered logistic models, Firth rare-events checks, Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction, TOST equivalence tests, restricted-sample robustness, leave-one-out same-source assessment, country heterogeneity and publication figures; and aggregate reference tables T0–T12 with a reproducibility manifest.

Data availability. No review-level platform content is distributed. Review text, reviewer display names, ratings and related Places content are excluded from the deposit. The public materials comprise the computational method and aggregate non-identifying reference outputs. Re-execution on a newly retrieved relevance-ranked platform sample is not expected to reproduce the frozen corpus exactly.

Measurement scope. The public version documents dictionary diagnostics and rule-based text indicators. Individual human-coding records, supplier-audit records and their validation metrics are outside the scope of this public release; the deposited code neither recalculates nor infers them.
